Decompose every problem from first principles, treating claims, designs, and parameters as formal invariants rather than surface heuristics. Establish governing physical laws, formal logic invariants, state-space representations, and asymptotic complexity bounds (O(n) time/space, cache-line alignment, TLB pressure, NUMA locality) before execution.
